text: {"rationale":"s2=B dramatically reduces f2 to ~2500-3200, while s2=A yields low f1 with high f2. In #2/#3, s5=B/C with s4=B yielded ultra-low f1=2443. We test s5=D with s4=A/B and s2=B variants to improve the low-f2 boundary.","configs":[{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"D"}]}

{"rationale":"Exploit the Pareto trade-off around s1=D/C/B with s2=B, s4=A, and s5=D to find optimal compromises between f1 (~5000-6000) and f2 (~2000-2600), testing unvisited s1/s3 combinations.","configs":[{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"E","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"A","s5":"D"}]}

{"rationale":"s2=B strongly optimizes f2 while s2=A yields low f1. Combining low-f1 features (s1=B, s4=B) with s2=B or testing s3=E with s2=B explores improvements along the Pareto front.","configs":[{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"B"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"E","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"E","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"C"}]}

{"rationale":"Exploit the low f2 region around s3=D, s5=C with s2=B. Testing remaining s5 options (D) with top candidates and varying s1/s4 to map trade-offs in low f1 and low f2 regions.","configs":[{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"B","s2":"A","s3":"E","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"D"}]}

{"rationale":"s4=B appears essential for low f2, while s1=B or A achieved the lowest f1. Testing s1=B with s2=B, s4=B combines low-f1 features with low-f2 features to discover new trade-off points.","configs":[{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"B","s2":"A","s3":"D","s4":"B","s5":"B"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"B","s5":"C"}]}

{"rationale":"s1=B, s3=C, s5=D dominates both f1 and f2 extremes. We test variations around this core to discover intermediate Pareto points and test if s4=A with s2=B or alternative s5 labels reduce f1 while maintaining low f2.","configs":[{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"E","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"D"}]}

{"rationale":"s1=D achieved the best f2 (2112) with s3=C, s4=B, s5=D. Combining s1=D with s3=E or other labels, and testing s5 variations, explores further improvements along the low-f2 edge of the Pareto front.","configs":[{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"E","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"D"}]}

{"rationale":"Evaluations show s4=A significantly reduces f2, while s1=A and s3=A yield low f1. Testing variants combining s1=A, s3=A, and s4=A explores optimal trade-offs between f1 and f2.","configs":[{"s1":"A","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"A"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"E"},{"s1":"A","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"E"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"A","s2":"A","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"A"}]}

{"rationale":"s4=B significantly reduces f1, while s2=B with s4=A yields low f2 (~2432). Evaluating s4=B with s5=A and s2=B explores whether lower f1 and intermediate f2 can be achieved. Testing other s5 labels adds diversity.","configs":[{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"A"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"B"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"D"}]}

{"rationale": "Evaluating s3=E with s2=A and s4=B to test for ultra-low f1, and exploring s1=C/D/E with s2=B, s4=A, s5=E to improve f2 and bridge the trade-off.", "configs": [{"s1": "A", "s2": "A", "s3": "E", "s4": "B", "s5": "E"}, {"s1": "C", "s2": "B", "s3": "E", "s4": "A", "s5": "E"}, {"s1": "D", "s2": "B", "s3": "E", "s4": "A", "s5": "E"}, {"s1": "B", "s2": "B", "s3": "E", "s4": "A", "s5": "E"}, {"s1": "E", "s2": "B", "s3": "E", "s4": "A", "s5": "E"}]}

{"rationale":"Test mixed caching to balance memory and logical reads: cache only one lookup (s2 or s4) alongside BULK/SET_BASED, exploring the intermediate PGA range between 2.3MB and 15MB.","configs":[{"s1":"BULK_5000","s2":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s3":"SET_BASED","s4":"LOOKUP_SQL","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"SET_BASED","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"BULK_5000","s4":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"BULK_50","s2":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s3":"BULK_50","s4":"LOOKUP_SQL","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"BULK_50","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"BULK_50","s4":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"BULK_5000","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"BULK_5000","s4":"LOOKUP_SQL","s5":"SET_BASED"}]}

{"rationale":"Test intermediate memory/IO points by isolating cache to s4 (lower PGA than s2 cache) with ROW/BULK combinations, and test s1=BULK_50/s3=SET_BASED to fill gaps near the low PGA region.","configs":[{"s1":"BULK_50","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"SET_BASED","s4":"LOOKUP_SQL","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"ROW","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"ROW","s4":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"ROW","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"SET_BASED","s4":"LOOKUP_SQL","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"BULK_50","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"ROW","s4":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"ROW","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"BULK_50","s4":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s5":"SET_BASED"}]}

{"rationale":"s5=C consistently yields low f2 while s4=B preserves low f2. We test remaining unmeasured combinations of s1 with s3=C/D for s5=C, particularly s1=D and s1=C where f1 could improve on Pareto solutions.","configs":[{"s1":"D","s2":"A","s3":"D","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"D","s2":"A","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"D","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"C","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"C"}]}

{"rationale":"s2=B dramatically lowers f1 when paired with s4=A (seen in config 3). Testing variations combining s2=B, s4=A, and promising settings of s1, s3, s5 to push the lower envelope of f1.","configs":[{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"A","s5":"B"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"B"},{"s1":"B","s2":"A","s3":"C","s4":"A","s5":"B"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"C"}]}

{"rationale":"s4=A strongly lowers f1 while s4=B dramatically reduces f2. For f1 minimization, s5=C and s2=B combined with s4=A yield the best f1 (~2324); exploring s5=D/E and s3=A/B with s4=A/s2=B may improve f1 further.","configs":[{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"D","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"B","s2":"A","s3":"D","s4":"B","s5":"D"}]}

{"rationale":"s4=A keeps f2 low while s1=E/B significantly reduces f1. Testing s4=A paired with low-f1 labels (E, B) and exploring s2/s3 interactions to discover balanced trade-offs.","configs":[{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"A","s5":"A"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"A","s5":"A"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"A"},{"s1":"E","s2":"A","s3":"C","s4":"A","s5":"A"}]}

{"rationale":"s2=B yields low f2 (~2.6-3.2k) while s2=A yields low f1 with high f2 (~16k). Exploring s1=B,C,D with s2=B combined with promising s3/s5 values targets the trade-off near low f1 and low f2.","configs":[{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"D","s2":"A","s3":"E","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"C","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"D","s4":"A","s5":"C"}]}
